name: Direct Download
description: Download files from direct URLs and save them to Google Drive using aria2 for maximum speed and reliability.

inputs.label: Download URL
inputs.description: Direct download link for the file

validation.message: Please enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL

inputs.label: Filename
inputs.description: Custom filename for the downloaded file (optional)

inputs.label: Destination Folder
inputs.description: Google Drive folder path to save the file

outputs.label: File Path
outputs.description: Full path of the downloaded file in Google Drive

outputs.label: File Size
outputs.description: Size of the downloaded file in bytes
